title: Finitely many Taylor coefficients of a formal local map are controlled by one finite type etale-like modification

standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit prerequisite boundary
standard_prerequisites.reference: Noetherian schemes, local rings, completion at the maximal ideal, finite type presentations; no cited result replaces the retained argument
standard_prerequisites.use: Noetherian local rings and their completions, finite type ring maps and their presentations by generators and relations, principal localisations, and the Taylor expansion of an element of the completion along a generating sequence of the maximal ideal. The control construction is retained in full.

core_obligations: Construct the finite type modification T' explicitly by adjoining variables t_{i,I} indexed by multi-indices I of total length N and imposing the relations c_i - r_i - sum_I t_{i,I} f_1^{i_1}...f_m^{i_m}, and check that sigma factors through it.
Prove the uniform control claim: every local O_{S,s}-algebra map sigma' that factors through C' agrees with sigma modulo m_s^N, which is the substantive point of the lemma.

proof_roadmap.step: Replace S and T by affine representatives S = Spec(R), T = Spec(C); choose R-algebra generators c_1,...,c_n of C and generators f_1,...,f_m of the prime p corresponding to s; clear denominators by a principal localisation of R.

spans.label: affine reduction, generators and denominator clearing

proof_roadmap.step: Expand each sigma(c_i) as r_i plus a sum over multi-indices of total length N, define C' by adjoining the t_{i,I} with the imposed relations, and conclude that any sigma' sends c_i to r_i modulo m_s^N.

spans.label: Taylor expansion, construction of C' and the agreement modulo m_s^N

difficulty_reason: This is the Artin approximation control step: given a local O_{S,s}-algebra map sigma from a finite type scheme to a complete local ring, one must manufacture a finite type morphism (T',t') -> (T,t) through which sigma factors and which pins down every other factorisation modulo the N-th power of the maximal ideal simultaneously. The construction is explicit but genuinely novel: choose algebra generators c_i, clear denominators by a principal localisation of R, expand each sigma(c_i) as r_i plus a sum over multi-indices of length N, then adjoin one formal variable t_{i,I} per coefficient and impose the relation c_i - r_i - sum t_{i,I} f_1^{i_1}...f_m^{i_m}. The obligation that all factorisations agree modulo m_s^N is discharged only after seeing that any sigma' sends each c_i to r_i modulo that power, which is the load-bearing observation. Retained author proof at lines 11544-11568.
